paper_metadata.title: Effect of niobium on microstructure and mechanical properties of high carbon Fe-10.5 wt.% Al alloys

evidence.quote: Effect of niobium on microstructure and mechanical properties of high carbon Fe–10.5 wt.% Al alloys
The effect of a combined addition of carbon and niobium as well as variation in concentration of carbon and niobium on structure and properties of ESR hot-rolled Fe–10.5Al alloys has been studied.

process_steps.method: air induction melting with flux cover (AIMFC)

evidence.quote: Forty-kilogram melts of five alloys were prepared by a combination of air induction-melting with flux cover (AIMFC) and electroslag remelting (ESR).
The ESR ingots of 80-mm diameter were held in the hearth furnace at 1373 K for 1 h and hot-forged in a 1000 kg hammer forge to a thickness of 24-mm.
